title: The Figure a Formulary Tier Gives for a Held Fill on a Ridgecrest RxSecure Plan
content:
The figure the formulary tier gives for a fill the pharmacy is holding on a Ridgecrest RxSecure stand-alone Medicare Part D prescription drug plan is chosen by the tier the held fill sits on.

1. Where the fill the pharmacy is holding sits on the preferred brand tier, the figure the formulary tier gives is the plan's preferred brand figure.
2. Where the fill the pharmacy is holding sits on the preferred generic tier, the figure the formulary tier gives is the plan's preferred generic figure.
3. Where the fill sits on any other tier, the figure the formulary tier gives is the plan's generic figure.

| Plan | Preferred brand figure (USD) | Preferred generic figure (USD) | Generic figure (USD) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Basic (PDP) | 47.0 | 0.0 | 8.0 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Value (PDP) | 44.0 | 0.0 | 6.0 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Select (PDP) | 42.0 | 1.0 | 5.0 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Plus (PDP) | 40.0 | 2.0 | 4.0 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Complete (PDP) | 37.0 | 0.0 | 3.0 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Premier (PDP) | 33.0 | 0.0 | 2.0 |

The third row of the rule is the one that governs a held fill on the non-preferred, specialty or select care tiers alike: on any tier other than preferred brand and preferred generic, the plan's generic figure is the figure the formulary tier gives.

## Worked on a hypothetical held fill

Take a held fill on Ridgecrest RxSecure Plus (PDP). Sitting on the preferred brand tier it earns 40.0 USD; sitting on the preferred generic tier it earns 2.0 USD; sitting on the specialty tier it earns the plan's generic figure of 4.0 USD.
